_source: CMA Quarterly Statistical Bulletin Issue 67/2026 (quarter ended June 2026), with two figures superseded by later KNBS and CBK releases. See _action on each key.
_how_to_apply: Admin > Config. Each entry below is one row: paste the object in `value` verbatim into the row named by the key. Keys marked no_write must be left alone. Rebuild the snapshot after saving.

benchmark.inflation._why: The bulletin prints 6.4 per cent for June 2026, but KNBS released July on 31 July at 6.5 per cent (CPI 155.20, core 3.2, non-core 15.0). Writing the bulletin figure would publish a number that is already one month stale. Current baked fallback is 6.7 (May), so this is a real move either way.

benchmark.cbr._why: Held at 8.75 at the 9 June 2026 MPC, the second consecutive hold. Matches the existing baked fallback, so this write only refreshes as_of and source. The next MPC sits on 11 August 2026, so re-check this key the day after.

benchmark.tbill_91._why: The bulletin's 8.83 for June is a monthly WEIGHTED AVERAGE across all auctions in the month, not an auction cut-off yield. The key is consumed as a current rate alongside tbill_182 and tbill_364, which are auction yields. Mixing the two measures makes the curve inconsistent, and a June average is stale against whatever CBK last auctioned. Leave this to the CBK auction source.

benchmark.tbill_182._why: Not published in this bulletin. CBK auction results are the source.

benchmark.tbill_364._why: Not published in this bulletin. CBK auction results are the source.

benchmark.wht_pct._why: No Finance Act change in the period. 15 per cent on interest stands.

benchmark.dividend_wht_pct._why: No Finance Act change in the period. 5 per cent final tax on resident dividends stands.

benchmark.inflation_usd._why: US CPI is not in a CMA bulletin. BLS is the source.

market.asset_classes._why: The bulletin's Table 37 (as at 31 March 2026) reproduces every share already baked into _assetClassFallback: 44.0 / 23.5 / 14.1 / 8.8 / 7.0 / 1.9 / 0.4 / 0.3. Independent confirmation that the current value is correct. Writing it changes no share, only stamps as_of and source, and adds per-class KES values the CIS report did not give.
market.asset_classes._note: marketAssetClasses() ignores value_kes, so this is forward-compatible and harmless. Total is 851,708,510,285 KES.

market.aum_by_fund_type._why: The bulletin reports AUM per SCHEME (43 managers), never per fund type. The mmf / fixed_income / equity / balanced / special split only exists in the dedicated CIS quarterly report. The Q1 2026 value in place stays correct: the underlying period (31 March 2026) has not moved.

fx.spread_pct._why: The bulletin's 129.50 USD/KES is the CBK end-period indicative, the same interbank series the doc comment on fxSpreadPct explicitly forbids wiring here. Nothing in this report is a retail quote. 1.5 stands until a real bank quote is captured.
